name: wechat-miniapp-devtools
description: Portable MCP and Agent workflows for developing, automating, and visually verifying WeChat Mini Programs.
longDescription: A generic, path-agnostic integration for stdio MCP clients. It wraps @creatoria/miniapp-mcp and the official WeChat DevTools CLI without bundling DevTools, bypassing login, or embedding machine-specific paths.

subAgents.description: Connects to WeChat DevTools automation, checks page state, assertions, and screenshots.
